formulas.ascii: For a matched planar segment s: measure = vertexMeasures[s] + fraction*sqrt(lengthSquared); normalizedMeasure = measure/lineLength when lineLength > 0, else 0. Segment selection minimizes distance within radius, ties to the lowest source row. Spherical mode adds along-angle times sphere radius, or copies the endpoint prefix for endpoint matches. Unmatched measures are NaN.
